230320101.text: Hello, Traveler. You couldn't have come at a better time.

230320103.text: Uh... Mr. Vsevolod found out that I've been carving wood in secret...

230320104.text: But he didn't really get angry about it. He just told me to stay focused while I'm at work... He even asked me for a wood carving of a bunny.

230320107.text: Mr. Vsevolod said that my wood carvings have a strong Snezhnayan style, and that he really likes them.

230320108.text: I've heard that Mr. Vsevolod's orders have kept him from going home to his family in Snezhnaya for a very long time now.

230320109.text: I think he might really be homesick, unlike me...

230320110.text: *sigh* Let's stop here. Traveler, I've ordered another batch of wood from Hamawi. Please help me take a look at how it's going.

230320203.text: Are you talking about the wood that the Fatuus ordered?

230320204.text: *sigh* I knew dealing with the Fatui wouldn't end well.

230320205.text: We were attacked by monsters while transporting that wood. All of us made it back alive, but our cart didn't. We were forced to leave the wood by the roadside.

230320206.text: I dare not go over there, nor can I find someone to get rid of those monsters so soon...

230320209.text: Aren't you a Fatuus? Then why are you helping him?

230320210.text: Anyway, I can only leave my cart there for now and see if I can hire someone to deal with the situation.

230320211.text: If you are anxious to get the wood, I'll mark the approximate location of the cart on the map for you, then you can go take a look for yourself.

230320212.text: *sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...

230321801.text: So, Traveler, how did it go?

230321804.text: Here's your payment. Now, I'll go back to writing Lily's letter.

230321805.text: *sigh* Writing a letter to her makes me more nervous than writing a report for Mr. Vsevolod...

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to where the cart is

230320301.text: I didn't expect myself to be able to pick up wood carving again...

subQuests.subQuestName: Defeat all the Fungi and retrieve the plank

230320401.text: *sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...

230320501.text: *sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...

230320503.text: This wood... You've chased away all the monsters? You're stronger than you look...

230320504.text: Thank you. I'll head over with a few others later and bring the wood back.

230320505.text: *sigh* Nothing good ever comes of things that the Fatui are involved in...

230320601.text: How did it go? Has my wood arrived?

230320603.text: Monsters again? Why does it feel like every cart in the world is being attacked by monsters...

230320604.text: Never mind. The wood got here, and that's what counts.

230320605.text: Oh, right. Here's the payment I promised you. Make sure to tally it up.

230320606.text: Uh, by the way... Um, is Lily doing well?

230320607.text: I didn't say goodbye to her before I left. I hope she isn't angry...

230320609.text: Alright. *cough*... Don't look at me like that. I was just a little concerned!

230320614.text: Anyway, make sure you tally your remuneration, Traveler. I prepared the exact amount.

230320611.text: Mr. Vsevolod will give me a real hiding if I do that, so forget it.

230320612.text: I don't quite dare to send a letter directly either.

230320613.text: Receiving a letter from a Fatuus sounds like a bad thing. Hahaha...

230320901.text: Hello there. Is there anything I can help you with?

230320903.text: Oh, this is about the spices he asked me to purchase, right? I've got them right here, and I'll send them over in a while.

230320904.text: Lunch? Oh my, we were quite busy today, so almost all the ingredients have been used up...

230320905.text: I know! Traveler, can you get me two potatoes?

230320906.text: In return... I'll make you some Panipuri. Thanks.

230321601.text: Did you get the Windwheel Aster?

230321101.text: Perfect. These should be enough. Please give me a moment.

230321103.text: It's done. This serving is for you. Please take the other two servings of Panipuri to those two.

230321203.text: Lambad really is a reliable boss and a really nice person.

230321204.text: Unlike the others who instinctively become wary of us when they find out that we're Fatui.

230321207.text: Oh, it smells really good. I bet Vsevolod would like it too.

230321209.text: And here's the payment I promised you. Tally it up if you have to.

230321501.text: What does a Windwheel Aster smell like?

230321503.text: Yes, I did make an agreement with him. He'll help me find rare plants, and I'll help him make a sachet.

230321504.text: You're the one he hired to help, right? If you get a Windwheel Aster, you can just pass it to me.

230321701.text: This is a Windwheel Aster? Hmm, an interesting plant indeed...

230321702.text: I'll take it. Tell him to leave making a sachet to me.

230321901.text: How did it go? Has the wood I ordered arrived?

230321903.text: Monsters again? Why does it feel like every cart in the world is being attacked by monsters...

230321904.text: Never mind, as long my wood gets here, I'm fine with it.

230321905.text: Oh, right. Here's the payment I promised you. Tally it up if you like.

230321907.text: Viktor, is this the Traveler you told me about?

230321908.text: Ahem! Yes! Commander, this is the Traveler!

230321909.text: What were you talking about? Did I interrupt you?

230321910.text: No sir! I was talking with the Traveler about the commission!

230321912.text: Hello, Traveler. It's an honor to be with you today.

230321914.text: Hello Traveler. Actually, I've already learned about you through various means.

230321915.text: Looks like you and us the Fatui are meant to meet.

230321916.text: Viktor told me that you refused to join the Fatui in Mondstadt.

230321917.text: I don't know if that's still your choice?

230321921.text: That's enough Viktor. I won't have any feelings about the Traveler's choice.

230321922.text: On the contrary... I respect those who stick to their choice and see it through.

230321924.text: I have no doubt about that.

230321925.text: If you would excuse me, I have other errands to run.

230321926.text: Hehe... I deeply believe that sooner or later we will have a chance to work together, Traveler.

230322005.text: What a "great" job to be a Fatuus nowadays, heh...

230322009.text: I was dealing with some stuff, and happened to pass by. I saw you discussing something with the Traveler...

230322010.text: I was talking with the Traveler about the commission, sir!

230322011.text: Mmm... Getting assigned from Mondstadt all the way to here is by no means easy. It's gonna take a while to settle in.

230322012.text: Let me know if you have any trouble.

230322014.text: And this... Traveler. Your reputation precedes you.

230322106.text: ... Got some business to tend to!

230322108.text: Ahem... Y—Yes! Commander, this is the Traveler I mentioned.

230322110.text: Mmm, hello Traveler. Actually, I've already learned about you through various means.

230322111.text: Looks like you and us the Fatui are meant to meet.

230322122.text: Hehe... I deeply believe that sooner or later we will have a chance to work together, traveler.

230320701.text: Traveler, perfect timing! Come over here and help me with something.

230320702.text: What are you up to now?

230320703.text: I'm trying to make a dish from Sumeru using Snezhnayan cooking methods.

230320704.text: But I don't recognize many spices from Sumeru, so I'm having to do it slowly by trial and error...

230320706.text: Uh... Inspecting the quality of spices is within the scope of my job, of course.

230320709.text: But let's get back to business. Because my... work schedule for inspecting the quality of spices has been too tight, the spices are consumed rapidly.

230320710.text: After some discussions with Mr. Vsevolod, we've decided to commission Mr. Lambad to purchase spices for us.

230320711.text: We're regulars at Mr. Lambad's tavern, so we trust his judgment.

230320712.text: Traveler, please help me ask Mr. Lambad about how the purchase of spices is going.

230320713.text: Besides that... Ask him if he has any good food ready. It's almost mealtime...

230320708.text: Huh? Uh... Sort of? I wouldn't consider it out of the ordinary. I go to work every day, after all.

230320801.text: Mr. Vsevolod is working all day. In fact, I've even heard that he hasn't been back to Snezhnaya in years. I really wonder how he made it up till now...

230321301.text: Why are these spices so expensive?

230321302.text: Have you not bought the spices yet?

230321303.text: Traveler! You're finally here. Uh... I have a question for you...

230321304.text: D—Do you have any Windwheel Aster?

230321307.text: Remember how I was busy with the spices? I heard Lambad mention something called a "sachet" during our discussion.

230321308.text: To be specific, various flowers are dried in a small cloth pouch, some even sprinkle a dash of perfume on it...

230321309.text: So, they tell me that ladies are really fond of these "sachets"...

230321401.text: How should I start my letter to Lily?

230321402.text: "Dear Lily"... Wait, I can't write that.

230321403.text: "Hi, Lily"... Well, that doesn't sound too bad...
